description: This file is a JavaScript module that provides a wrapper around the search API for a video streaming platform. It includes functions to fetch search results from a backend API or fall back to local mock data, and maps API results to a UI-compatible format.

methods.name: mapApiResultToVideo(item, index = 0)
methods.description: Maps a backend API result shape into the UI VideoCard-compatible shape, adjusting for various possible API response fields.

methods.name: timeSince(input)
methods.description: Helper function to generate a relative time string from a date input.

methods.name: fetchSearchResults(query, pageToken)
methods.description: Main function that queries the backend API for search results, or uses mock data if the backend is unavailable.

methods.name: loadMock(q)
methods.description: Loads mock search results from a local JSON file and filters them based on the query.
